text:
Samira: Heads up traveling to Oakland this Thurs for a customer meeting. Any good lunch spots near Jack London Square? client-friendly, not too loud.
Ethan: Lake Chalet is nice for views and a calm table, but pricier. Shakewell is tapas-style and great for sharing with clients.
Pri: Miss Ollie's is great if you want southern comfort and a relaxed vibe; also good for brunch.
Samira: Would want something where we can talk without shouting. Parking available?
Ethan: There's an underground garage at Jack London Square. Street parking exists but fills up quick around lunch on weekdays. Give yourself +10-15 mins.
Pri: For quieter cafes, try Highwire Coffee or The Dockside Cafe - calmer and good for a quick meeting.
Samira: Any private-ish spots if we need a little space for a 20-min walkthrough?
Ethan: Shakewell can do a corner table if you reserve; otherwise Lake Chalet has booths. Also Everett & Jones BBQ has bigger tables if client is into BBQ.
bento-bot: Team picks near Jack London: Shakewell (reserve), Lake Chalet, Highwire Coffee. Added to Redwood curated eats.
Samira: Perfect. Bonus q: flying to Seattle next week, any must-try seafood near Pike Place?
Pri: Pike Place Chowder is a classic quick stop. For sit-down, Matt's in the Market is reliably good. The Crab Pot is fun but touristy.
Ethan: Also check out The Athenian for diner vibes and good seafood plates.
Samira: Awesome, thanks. Quick poll  who's up for a pre-trip lunch Tue 12:00 so I can run through the deck? react with :white_check_mark: for yes
Ethan: :white_check_mark:
Pri: :white_check_mark:
